scope: Actual review of seven sampled stills covering Soldier Field, Burnham Harbor and the corrected southern shoreline. Does not cover Shedd or claim whole-world/media approval.
renderRevision: Generated before the subsequent Shedd ticket-pavilion/cafe/path-junction correction; exact images are identified by hashes.

images.observation: Clear stadium exterior: continuous classical porticos, open lower supports, silver/glass east crescent and taller upper seating bank. No generic stadium slab or side blocks.
Portico columns receive restrained warm light; suite facade and upper aisles remain readable. Most surrounding lawn and unlit seating stay dark. No new geometric obstruction.
Mapped shoreline and piers meet water cleanly. Representative white/navy hulls, cabins, masts and low harbor facilities are visible; no tall generic harbor offices.
Selected warm cabins, dock pedestal pools and short water reflections define the marina. Unoccupied boats and foreground paths remain dark as documented.
Corrected turf has smooth grass variation and alternating mowing bands; prior brick/masonry joints are absent. Yard lines, hash marks, goal, seating and aisles are visible and unobstructed.
Closer marina view shows occupied cabin strips and nearby dock illumination reflected in water. Most rigging is visible only in silhouette; no all-boat floodlighting.
Open lake extends continuously beyond the south shoreline. The prior bright triangular land cap is absent.

limits: Sampled1600×1000 still images do not establish all-frame animation continuity or temporal noise quality.
Nighttime harbor is deliberately subdued; many unoccupied boats and mast details remain dark.
Boat occupancy, building finishes, seating and lighting are architectural interpretations.
The separate Shedd-context correction requires its own fresh image and playback checks.
